description: A false-colour infrared satellite or aerial photograph depicting an agricultural landscape, identified as managed (improved) grasslands in Friesland, The Netherlands. The image, sourced from Eurostat's LUCAS (Land Use/Cover Area frame Survey) 2012, displays multiple rectangular fields predominantly in bright red, which indicates healthy vegetation in this spectral representation. A distinct small green square marker is positioned centrally within one of these red fields, highlighting a specific sampling point. Scattered darker patches, potentially other vegetation or shadows, and a few lighter grey/white structures (likely buildings) are visible amongst the fields. A dark body of water occupies the lower-left corner of the image.
